output.response_text:
Dear Enterprise Client 19,

Thank you for bringing the intermittent 500 Internal Server Error you are seeing on our API webhook to our attention. We understand how critical reliable webhook delivery is for your operations, and we are treating this with the highest priority.

To diagnose the issue effectively, could you please provide the following information?

- The exact timestamps (and, if available, log excerpts or error IDs) when the 500 errors were observed.
- The full webhook endpoint URL you are using.
- Details of any recent changes made on your side (e.g., configuration updates, code deployments, network changes).

Once we receive these details, we will:
1. Retrieve our server‑side logs and metrics for the reported windows.
2. Correlate your timestamps with our internal data to identify any deployment or resource‑related anomalies.
3. Perform controlled test calls to your endpoint to reproduce the error.
4. If a deployment‑related bug or resource exhaustion is confirmed, we will open an Engineering Change Request and keep you updated with an ETA in line with our 4‑hour resolution SLA.

We appreciate your cooperation and will keep you informed at each step.

Best regards,
Technical Support Team
